connector.name: Marketo
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Marketo - 32 tools for leads, programs, emails, forms, lists, and bulk export.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package marketo-mcp-server. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the zleventer account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
